## Research Overview

My research activities focus on the development of intelligent biomedical systems combining **biomedical signal processing**, **embedded systems**, **TinyML**, and **artificial intelligence**.

## Main Research Areas

- Biomedical Engineering
- ECG Signal Processing
- TinyML
- Embedded Artificial Intelligence
- Edge AI
- Embedded Systems
- Internet of Things for Healthcare

## Current Research

### TinyML for ECG Classification

Development of lightweight deep-learning models for ECG beat classification and their deployment on resource-constrained embedded devices.

### Embedded ECG Monitoring

Design and validation of embedded and IoT-based architectures for ECG acquisition, processing, analysis, and monitoring.

### Intelligent Biomedical Instrumentation

Development of smart biomedical instrumentation combining sensing, signal processing, embedded computing, and artificial intelligence.
